description: This Java source file defines a class 'EnableExternalEventQueueCondition' that extends 'PropertiesCondition'. Its main purpose is to determine whether an external event queue should be enabled based on the presence of a non-blank JMS event queue name in the Fineract properties configuration.

classes.name: EnableExternalEventQueueCondition
classes.description: A condition class that checks whether the external event queue is enabled by verifying the presence of a non-empty JMS event queue name in the configuration properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overridden method that returns true if the 'eventQueueName' in the properties configuration is not blank, indicating that the external event queue should be enabled.
